name: YouTube Shorts: title only (no description) vs full description
window: Mon 2 Nov to Sun 15 Nov 2026 (14 days, one Short per day, alternating)
scope: YouTube only. TikTok and Instagram captions are unchanged.

group_title_only.pending_when_scheduled: 27 (10 Nov) and 24 (12 Nov): schedule on Buffer YouTube with text empty and only metadata.youtube title + categoryId 28; the edit_post/create_post call needs the video asset carried forward.

group_full_description.note: Normal description: summary, referral link with disclosure, sources, hashtags.

compare: Views (and engaged views, average view percentage, subscribers gained) at the same age for every video, e.g. day 3 and day 7, not total views at review date. Use vidIQ or YouTube Studio. Report medians and the range, and say plainly that 7 vs 8 videos on different topics is a weak test.
caveats: Title-only videos have no referral link, no disclosure line and no sources in the description, so referral clicks from the description are lost on those days.
Topic, weekday and hook differ between videos; differences in views may not come from the description.
